title: Amazing sunset cruise with guitar player
text: We visited our son who was traveling abroad and booked the 2 hour Catamaran sunset cruise with guitar player for my son, his 5 roommates and another family.   The staff was amazing and attentive and the kids said it was one of their best nights during their time abroad.   I would highly recommend this great company!
author: Gleobabe

title: Great crew! Great Day!
text: Our crew was excellent and very accommodating. They catered to the adults in our group as well as the children. Would highly recommend!
author: Caridad_C
